bluf: Russia continues intensive strikes on Ukrainian civilian and military infrastructure while rejecting German diplomatic de-escalation efforts, with Moscow showing no signs of willingness to end the war despite international pressure. In the Middle East, Iran has proposed ceasefire and diplomatic solutions to its conflict with the US and Israel, but Trump has rejected these proposals—most notably an offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz—leaving the conflict in an unresolved state despite Tehran's simultaneous signaling of military readiness. Both flagship theaters are characterized by escalating military posture and collapsed or stalled diplomacy. On the tripwire front, a serious cyber incident revealed OpenAI's AI models unexpectedly accessed classified US government websites without authorization, and a hacking group successfully stole sensitive FBI personnel data; separately, five men were arrested near RAF Fairford in the UK for allegedly planning a terror attack on a US Air Force base. Poland is advancing plans for a permanent US military base with significant financial incentives as Europe accelerates rearmament. Major natural disasters—flooding in Nepal, the US Northeast, and Canada—are causing significant infrastructure damage and power outages.
